deviations.what: t8 was briefed with the nvidia checkpoint as the flip target but could not find it in the catalog (t1 had not merged yet), so it resolved the target to the unsloth sibling and wrote both its rollout note and its per-model doc section against that checkpoint. The main agent corrected the identity after merging, kept the unsloth recipe as an explicit labelled FALLBACK rather than deleting measured work, and cross-referenced the 2026-05-31 record of this exact nvidia id failing to load on vLLM 0.19/0.21
deviations.reason: a wave-0 ordering gap: t8 and t1 ran in parallel, and t8's premise depended on t1's output existing. The dependency was real but not expressed in the graph

deviations.what: the plan's stated rollback for t10 ('re-render the previous shape and restore the saved .env') is not sufficient on its own: the reverse-render dry run shows lobes init is MERGE-ONLY for .env (existing lines never rewritten) and leaves compose files untouched without --force. The operative rollback is restoring the backup directory; the render only rebuilds the shape override
deviations.reason: measured by dry-running the reverse render on the live box, as c29/h25 required — the dry run is what exposed the merge-only semantics

deviations.what: t7's pressure-floor question was answered by probing rather than by re-measuring hand: model=hand is unservable from EVERY box in this mesh today, because the Thor proxies it to the Spark (which declares it infeasible) and the only box declaring it feasible (the Orin) is not running the lane. The floor's absence is therefore pre-existing, not created by this flip
deviations.reason: re-measuring hand on the Thor would have re-run a known-broken result on an un-upgraded engine, at the cost of a heavy-lobe recreate on a box also serving the Culture production stack

deviations.what: t13's cross-box acceptance criterion ('a peer box reaches the lane as model=worker and the answer carries X-Lobes-Proxied-By') is NOT met. The Thor serves worker locally and answers model=cortex by proxy to the Spark, both verified 200, but no peer declares a WORKER_PEER_ORIGIN pointing at the Thor, so model=worker on the Spark still reports feasible=false with the stale Nemotron id
deviations.reason: wiring the Spark and the Orin requires editing their own .env files, and this box has no SSH access to them (publickey denied). It is an operator action on those boxes, not something this run can perform or fake

deviations.what: the deployed worker lane serves the FULL native 262144 window, not the 65536 the spike measured and t15 committed to the shape TOML
deviations.reason: a real consumer broke on the smaller window: Qwen Code requests 64000 output tokens by default and 65536 cannot hold that plus a prompt (HTTP 400). 262144 booted cleanly at the same util with KV pool 1,199,883 tokens = 4.58x. The shape TOML's 65536 is now behind the deployed reality

deviations.what: the deployed docker-compose.yml was hand-patched with two of t3's knob slots (WORKER_KV_CACHE_DTYPE, WORKER_MAX_NUM_SEQS) rather than re-scaffolded from the packaged template
deviations.reason: without --kv-cache-dtype=fp8 the deployed lane could not hold util 0.45 and fell to a 4.61x KV ceiling; re-scaffolding the whole file was refused because it is hand-edited (the #214 drift condition c29 names). Backup at ~/.lobes/docker-compose.yml.pre-244
